analyst.summary: JSW Cement is a fast-growing, recently-listed green-cement manufacturer, but our research turned up one very large unexplained quarterly loss (roughly Rs.1,366cr) that could be either a one-off, non-cash IPO-related accounting item or a genuine impairment - we could not confirm which from available sources, and this materially affects how trustworthy the reported book value and returns are. Setting that aside, underlying returns on capital are modest (high single digits) for a stock trading at nearly 2.8 times book value. We recommend keeping this a Sell and flagging the loss-quarter uncertainty for portfolio-manager review.
